29206-happy-ending.title: Happy Ending
29206-happy-ending.creator: Unknown
29206-happy-ending.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Only in some place like this, alone, was safety for him. Elsewhere--anywhere--imprisonment or, more likely, death. There was danger, even here. Three of the crew of the space-cruiser knew. Perhaps, someday, one of them would talk. Then they would come for him, even here.

51488-the-year-s-at-the-spring-an-anthol.title: The Year S At The Spring An Anthology Of Recent Poetry
51488-the-year-s-at-the-spring-an-anthol.creator: Unknown
51488-the-year-s-at-the-spring-an-anthol.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The collection as a whole is modern, and all except eight of its authors are living and writing. Of those eight, five died as soldiers in the European War, and are represented mainly by what is known as 'War poetry.' Otherwise such poetry is fortunately absent.

alice-in-wonderland-retold-in-words-of-o.title: Alice in Wonderland, Retold in Words of One Syllable
alice-in-wonderland-retold-in-words-of-o.creator: Lewis Carroll

arxiv-1810-09533.title: Asymptotic uncertainty quantification for communities in sparse planted bi-section models Journal: Journal of Statistical Planning and Inference
arxiv-1810-09533.creator: B. J. K. Kleijn, J. van Waaij
arxiv-1810-09533.description: Abstract Posterior distributions for community structure in sparse planted bi-section models are shown to achieve exact (resp. almost-exact) recovery, with sharp bounds for the sparsity regimes where edge probabilities decrease as O ⁡ ( log ⁡ ( n ) / n ) O(\log(n)/n) (resp. O ⁡ ( 1 / n ) O(1/n) ).

arxiv-1907-08874.title: ADAPS: Autonomous Driving Via Principled Simulations
arxiv-1907-08874.creator: Weizi Li, David Wolinski, Ming C. Lin
arxiv-1907-08874.description: Abstract Autonomous driving has gained significant advancements in recent years. However, obtaining a robust control policy for driving remains challenging as it requires training data from a variety of scenarios, including rare situations (e.g., accidents), an effective policy architecture, and an efficient learning mechanism. We propose ADAPS for producing robust control policies for autonomous vehicles.

arxiv-2106-03703.title: A variational approach for the ground state profile of a trapped spinor-BEC: A detailed study of phase transition in spin-1 condensate at zero magnetic field
arxiv-2106-03703.creator: Projjwal K. Kanjilal, A. Bhattacharyay
arxiv-2106-03703.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Projjwal K. Kanjilal, A. Bhattacharyay. In this article we introduce a multi-modal variational method to analytically estimate the full number- and corresponding energy-density profile of a spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) for number of particles as low as 500 under harmonic confinement. To apply this method, we consider a system of spin-1 BEC under three dimensional isotropic and effective one-dimensional harmonic confinement in absence (negligible presence) of magnetic field which has ground state candidates of comparable energy.

arxiv-2112-12988.title: iSeg3D: An Interactive 3D Shape Segmentation Tool
arxiv-2112-12988.creator: Sucheng Qian, Liu Liu, Wenqiang Xu, Cewu Lu
arxiv-2112-12988.description: Abstract A large-scale dataset is essential for learning good features in 3D shape understanding, but there are only a few datasets that can satisfy deep learning training. One of the major reasons is that current tools for annotating per-point semantic labels using polygons or scribbles are tedious and inefficient.

arxiv-2211-02192.title: A Mixed Model Approach for Estimating Regional Functional Connectivity from Voxel-level BOLD Signals
arxiv-2211-02192.creator: Chao Zhang, Chau B. Tran, Sophie Achard, Wendy Meiring, Alexander Petersen
arxiv-2211-02192.description: Abstract Resting state brain functional connectivity quantifies the similarity between brain regions, each of which consists of voxels at which dynamic signals are acquired via neuroimaging techniques such as blood-oxygen-level-dependent signals in functional magnetic resonance imaging. Pearson correlation and similar metrics have been adopted by neuroscientists to estimate inter-regional connectivity, usually after averaging of signals within regions.

arxiv-2211-09193.title: Dirac operators with exponentially decaying entropy Thanks: The work is supported by Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation, agreement 075–15–2022–287
arxiv-2211-09193.creator: Pavel Gubkin
arxiv-2211-09193.description: Abstract . We prove that the Weyl function of the one-dimensional Dirac operator on the half-line ℝ + \mathbb{R}_{+} with exponentially decaying entropy extends meromorphically into the horizontal strip { 0 ⩾ Im z > − δ } \{0\geqslant\mathop{\mathrm{Im}}\nolimits z>-\delta\} for some δ > 0 \delta>0 depending on the rate of decay.

arxiv-2305-17480.title: A Match Made in Heaven: A Multi-task Framework for Hyperbole and Metaphor Detection
arxiv-2305-17480.creator: Naveen Badathala, Abisek Rajakumar Kalarani, Tejpalsingh Siledar Pushpak BhattacharyaDepartment of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Bombay, India {naveenbadathala, abisekrk, tejpalsingh, pb}@cse.iitb.ac.in
arxiv-2305-17480.description: Abstract Hyperbole and metaphor are common in day-to-day communication ( e.g. , "I am in deep trouble": how does trouble have depth ?), which makes their detection important, especially in a conversational AI setting. Existing approaches to automatically detect metaphor and hyperbole have studied these language phenomena independently, but their relationship has hardly, if ever, been explored computationally.

arxiv-2405-09277.title: Generalized cluster states from Hopf algebras: non-invertible symmetry and Hopf tensor network representation
arxiv-2405-09277.creator: Zhian Jia
arxiv-2405-09277.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhian Jia. Cluster states are crucial resources for measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC). It exhibits symmetry-protected topological (SPT) order, thus also playing a crucial role in studying topological phases. We present the construction of cluster states based on Hopf algebras.

arxiv-2412-03095.title: Decentralized Mobile Target Tracking Using Consensus-Based Estimation with Nearly-Constant-Velocity Modeling
arxiv-2412-03095.creator: Amir Ahmad Ghods, Mohammadreza Doostmohammadian
arxiv-2412-03095.description: Abstract Mobile target tracking is crucial in various applications such as surveillance and autonomous navigation. This study presents a decentralized tracking framework utilizing a Consensus-Based Estimation Filter (CBEF) integrated with the Nearly-Constant-Velocity (NCV) model to predict a moving target’s state.

arxiv-2502-01392.title: Characterising the Surface Resistance of Laser-Treated LHC Beam Screens with the Shielded Pair Method
arxiv-2502-01392.creator: Patrick Krkotić, Elena Bez, Kristóf Brunner, Sergio Calatroni, Maleesh Dissanayake, Marcel Himmerlich, Ana Karen Reascos Portilla, Mauro Taborelli, Matthew James Watkins
arxiv-2502-01392.description: Abstract The presence of strong electron clouds in the quadrupole magnetic field regions of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) leads to considerable heating that poses challenges for the cryogenic cooling system, and under certain conditions to proton beam quality deterioration. Research is being conducted on laser-treated inner beam screen surfaces for the upgraded High-Luminosity LHC to mitigate this issue.

arxiv-2503-21395.title: Polarized equatorial emission and hot spots around black holes with a dark matter halo
arxiv-2503-21395.creator: Tsanimir Angelov, Rasim Bekir, Galin Gyulchev, Petya Nedkova, Stoytcho Yazadjiev
arxiv-2503-21395.description: Abstract We study the linear polarization of the accretion disk around black holes with a dark matter halo. The interaction of the black hole with the dark matter is modelled by considering an exact solution to the Einstein equations which describes a superposition of the Schwarzschild black hole with a Hernquist-type matter distribution.

arxiv-2601-06252.title: One-loop renormalization and 𝝆 \boldsymbol{\rho} parameter in the Georgi-Machacek model
arxiv-2601-06252.creator: Debtosh Chowdhury ID ,1, , Anirban Kundu ID ,2, , Poulami Mondal ID ,1,3, , Subrata Samanta ID ,1, , Aaryan Srivastava ID ,1, 1 Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, Kanpur 208016, India 2 Department of Physics, University of Calcutta, 92 Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road, Kolkat
arxiv-2601-06252.description: Abstract We study the one-loop renormalization of the Georgi-Machacek model. At one loop, the renormalization of the model is phenomenologically important when triggered by operators that are absent at the tree level due to the global S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) R SU(2)_{R} symmetry.

pmc-10559850.title: A systematic review of prediction models for spontaneous preterm birth in singleton asymptomatic pregnant women with risk factors
pmc-10559850.creator: Chunmei Yan, Qiuyu Yang, Richeng Li, Aijun Yang, Yu Fu, Jieneng Wang, Ying Li, Qianji Cheng, Shasha Hu
pmc-10559850.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundsSpontaneous preterm birth (SPB) is a global problem. Early screening, identification, and prevention in asymptomatic pregnant women with risk factors for preterm birth can help reduce the incidence and mortality of preterm births.

pmc-10673002.title: Printed Capillary Microfluidic Devices and Their Application in Biosensing
pmc-10673002.creator: Zhiyi Zhang, Stephen Lang, Kate Pearson, Yawar Farhan, Ye Tao, Gaozhi Xiao
pmc-10673002.description: Microfluidic devices with a free-standing structure were printed directly on polymer films using the functional materials that form interconnected pores. The printed devices can transport fluids by capillary action in the same fashion as paper-based microfluidic devices, and they can handle much smaller sample volumes than typical paper-based devices.

pmc-11272637.title: Hip dysplasia—the Bernese contribution continues
pmc-11272637.creator: Richard E Field
pmc-11272637.description: ngle osteotomies [6–8], double osteotomies [9, 10] and triple osteotomies [11–13] has enabled tens of thousands of young people to enjoy active lives and delayed or prevented their need for hip arthroplasty. Throughout our careers, we adapt and refine our practice.

pmc-11439212.title: Differential proteins from EVs identification based on tandem mass tags analysis and effect of Treg-derived EVs on T-lymphocytes in COPD patients
pmc-11439212.creator: Xuefang Tao, Zhisong Xu, Hai Tian, Jingfeng He, Guowen Wang, Xuexia Tao
pmc-11439212.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a widespread respiratory disease. This study examines extracellular vesicles (EVs) and proteins contained in EVs in COPD.MethodsBlood samples were collected from 40 COPD patients and 10 health controls. Cytokines including IFN-γ, TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-8, and IL-17, were measured by ELISA.

pmc-11449927.title: A Bayesian analysis of heart rate variability changes over acute episodes of bipolar disorder
pmc-11449927.creator: Filippo Corponi, Bryan M Li, Gerard Anmella, Clàudia Valenzuela-Pascual, Isabella Pacchiarotti, Marc Valentí, Iria Grande, Antonio Benabarre, Marina Garriga, Eduard Vieta, Stephen M Lawrie, Heather C Whalley, Diego Hidalgo-Mazzei, Antonio Vergari
pmc-11449927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Bipolar disorder (BD) involves autonomic nervous system dysfunction, detectable through heart rate variability (HRV). HRV is a promising biomarker, but its dynamics during acute mania or depression episodes are poorly understood. Using a Bayesian approach, we developed a probabilistic model of HRV changes in BD, measured by the natural logarithm of the Root Mean Square of Successive RR interval Differences (lnRMSSD). Patients were assessed three to four times from episode onset to euthymia.

pmc-11512128.title: A Texting- and Internet-Based Self-Reporting System for Enhanced Vaccine Safety Surveillance With Insights From a Large Integrated Health Care System in the United States: Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-11512128.creator: Debbie E Malden, Julianne Gee, Sungching Glenn, Zhuoxin Li, Denison S Ryan, Zheng Gu, Cassandra Bezi, Sunhea Kim, Amelia Jazwa, Michael M McNeil, Eric S Weintraub, Sara Y Tartof, Lorraine Buis, Chariklia Tziraki, Anne Hause
pmc-11512128.description: BackgroundSMS text messaging- and internet-based self-reporting systems can supplement existing vaccine safety surveillance systems, but real-world participation patterns have not been assessed at scale.ObjectiveThis study aimed to describe the participation rates of a new SMS text messaging- and internet-based self-reporting system called the Kaiser Permanente Side Effect Monitor (KPSEM) within a large integrated health care system.

pmc-12635262.title: Task-specific pain-related fear influences lifting biomechanics differently in individuals with and without occupations involving repetitive lifting tasks
pmc-12635262.creator: Christian Bangerter, Oliver Faude, Denise Weidinger, André Meichtry, Michael L. Meier, Carol-Claudius Hasler, Stefan Schmid
pmc-12635262.description: Higher task-specific pain-related fear has been linked to restricted lumbar spine range of motion (ROM) during lightweight object lifting in chronic low back pain (LBP) patients and reduced lumbar spine flexion angles in healthy individuals, suggesting protective movement strategies. However, it remains unclear whether these findings apply to individuals who repetitively lift heavier objects at work.

pmc-13307849.title: Microplastic Contamination in Amphibians and Reptiles: An Ecotoxicological Synthesis of Exposure, Mechanisms, and Risk Implications
pmc-13307849.creator: Ahmet Ali Berber, Cansu Akbulut, Şefika Nur Demir, Muammer Kurnaz

pmc-13343625.title: Accuracy of automated segmentation of gluteus and paraspinal muscles in patients with hip osteoarthritis using TotalSegmentator in 3Dslicer
pmc-13343625.creator: Hyonmin Choe, Shogo Yokota, Ryohei Iino, Koki Abe, Hironori Yamane, Yuta Hieda, Hiroyuki Ike, Ken Kumagai, Naomi Kobayashi, Yutaka Inaba
pmc-13343625.description: BackgroundMuscle atrophy is prevalent among patients with hip osteoarthritis, yet quantitative assessment of the peri-hip muscles remains challenging. Although computed tomography (CT) enables objective evaluation, manual segmentation is time-consuming and impractical for routine use. TotalSegmentator, an artificial intelligence-based extension of 3D Slicer, allows rapid automated muscle segmentation.

pmc-13348251.title: Flexible artificial lateral line based on luminous flux for underwater velocity vector estimation
pmc-13348251.creator: Xintao Wang, Zhengwei Li, Zhuoliang Zhang, Junfeng Fan, Yaming Ou, Xiangyu Sun, Min Tan, Long Cheng, Chao Zhou
pmc-13348251.description: When fish swim, a specific ‘water flow field’ forms around their bodies. The lateral line system can provide real-time feedback on flow field variations through the stimulation of hair cells by water currents. Therefore, this paper developed a flexible artificial lateral line (ALL) sensor unit based on the principle of luminous flux that measures flow velocity vector.

pmc-13377855.title: A novel prognostic model based on MVIRGs identifies ANGPT2 as a key target driving the malignant progression of HCC
pmc-13377855.creator: Xian Li, Zhouli Tan, Shanru Feng, Qiang Yu, Jian Zhou, Jia Fan, Yang Xu
pmc-13377855.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a highly lethal malignancy with high recurrence and limited therapies. Microvascular invasion (MVI) is a critical prognostic factor, but its molecular mechanisms and precise predictive tools are lacking. This study aimed to identify key MVI-associated genes (MVIRGs), develop a prognostic model, and elucidate the role of ANGPT2 in HCC progression and therapeutic responses.

pmc-13404993.title: Characteristics of urologists participating in Medicare Advantage networks and implications for prostate cancer care
pmc-13404993.creator: Avinash Maganty, Eran Politzer, Asa Hartman, Brent K Hollenbeck, Bruce Landon
pmc-13404993.description: BackgroundEnrollment in Medicare Advantage (MA) has expanded rapidly and MA plans may rely on selective provider networks to manage utilization. While selective contracting has been described for primary care physicians, less is known about how MA networks are constructed for surgical specialists such as urologists, who manage common and costly conditions including prostate cancer.

pmc-13408184.title: High‐Resolution Elemental Analysis of Neuromelanin‐Containing Organelles in Human Locus Coeruleus
pmc-13408184.creator: Zahraa Berro, Fabio A Zucca, Maria Angels Subirana, Adrian‐Marie Philippe, Dirk Schaumlöffel, Anaïs Carpentier, Andrea Capucciati, David Bouvier, Michel Mittelbronn, Jean‐Nicolas Audinot, Luigi Zecca, Antje Biesemeier
pmc-13408184.description: Neuromelanin‐(NM) containing organelles are sub‐cellular auto‐lysosomal structures composed of three main compartments: NM pigment, protein matrix, and lipid bodies. These organelles accumulate during aging and are found predominantly in the catecholaminergic neurons of Substantia Nigra (SN) and Locus Coeruleus (LC), the main regions affected in Parkinson's disease (PD).
